# Random Canvas Game Idea

A minimalist endless‑runner where the player controls a small shape navigating a procedurally generated path. The player must jump over or slide under obstacles; hitting any obstacle or falling off the path triggers an immediate lose condition. Simple controls (tap/space to jump, down arrow to slide) keep the game accessible while challenging reflexes.
